title: eDNA Extraction of 47mm Membrane Filters Using Zymo Miniprep Plus Kit
author: Eldridge Wisely
materials: Let sit at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Write the concentrations in your lab notebook.

steps.title: Decontaminate work area
steps.instruction: Clean the extraction area with bleach or DNA Away and expose to UV for at least 15 minutes, if possible.

steps.title: Power on equipment
steps.instruction: Turn on the hula mixer/incubator and set it to 55 °C and 124 rpm.

steps.title: Reconstitute Proteinase K
steps.instruction: If Proteinase K powder is not yet prepared, add 1 040 µL of the kit buffer to the Proteinase K tube and mix.

steps.title: Add Proteinase K to samples
steps.instruction: Pipette 20 µL of Proteinase K into each 5 mL sample tube.

steps.title: Proteinase K digestion
steps.instruction: Incubate the tubes at 55 °C for 15 minutes on their sides in the hula mixer set to 124 rpm.

steps.title: First vortex
steps.instruction: Vortex the samples for 5 minutes at room temperature (RT) using speed setting 4.

steps.title: Prepare spin columns
steps.instruction: Prepare and label spin columns for each sample.

steps.title: Add genomic binding buffer
steps.instruction: Add 420 µL of genomic binding buffer to each sample tube.

steps.title: Second vortex
steps.instruction: Vortex the samples again for 5 minutes at RT using speed setting 4.

steps.title: Transfer lysate to columns
steps.instruction: Transfer 840 µL of lysate from each sample tube to its corresponding spin column.

steps.title: Centrifuge lysate through columns
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the spin columns at maximum speed (≥12 000 × g) for 1 minute.

steps.title: Process remaining lysate
steps.instruction: Repeat the transfer of lysate (step 9) and centrifugation (step 10) until all lysate from each sample has been processed.

steps.title: Pre‑wash columns
steps.instruction: Place each spin column in a new collection tube and add 400 µL DNA pre‑wash buffer.

steps.title: Optional Qubit buffer equilibration
steps.instruction: If Qubit quantification will be performed later, bring the Qubit buffer and standards to room temperature now.

steps.title: First g‑DNA wash
steps.instruction: Add 700 µL of g‑DNA Wash Buffer to each spin column.

steps.title: Centrifuge wash 1
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at maximum speed for 1 minute and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Second g‑DNA wash
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of g‑DNA Wash Buffer to each spin column.

steps.title: Centrifuge wash 2
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at maximum speed for 1 minute. Cut off the caps of fresh 1.5 mL tubes (or use cap‑less tubes) to hold the spin columns in the next step.

steps.title: Place columns in elution tubes
steps.instruction: Place each spin column into a 1.5 mL tube with the cap removed.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of warm (55 °C) DNA Elution Buffer directly onto the filter in each spin column.

steps.title: Centrifuge elution
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at maximum speed for 1 minute to collect eluate.

steps.title: Collect eluate
steps.instruction: Transfer the DNA eluate to a new Lo‑Bind 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube and label the tube.

steps.title: Final spin‑column spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the empty spin columns at maximum speed for 1 minute and discard any residual liquid.

steps.title: Prepare Qubit assay tubes
steps.instruction: Place two more tubes than the number of samples into a clean empty 1 000 µL tip box.

steps.title: Add sample to Qubit tubes
steps.instruction: Add 2 µL of each DNA sample to its respective Qubit tube; close and label the tubes.

steps.title: Add standards to Qubit tubes
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL of each Qubit standard to its designated tube; close and label.

steps.title: Add Qubit buffer
steps.instruction: Add 198 µL of 1× HS Qubit buffer (protect from light) to each sample tube and 190 µL of 1× HS Qubit buffer to the two extra tubes.

steps.title: Mix Qubit reactions
steps.instruction: Close the tubes tightly, vortex for 10 seconds ensuring no bubbles, then place the tube box back in the drawer for at least 2 minutes (no more than 30 minutes).

steps.title: Run Qubit assay
steps.instruction: Plug in the Qubit reader, select the 1× HS dsDNA assay, run standards (standard 1 then standard 2), then run the samples using 2 µL of each sample and report results in ng/µL.

steps.title: Prepare extraction negative control (Shield stored)
steps.instruction: If samples were stored in 400 µL DNA/RNA Shield, add 400 µL DNA/RNA Shield to a negative‑control 5 mL tube.

steps.title: Prepare extraction negative control (non‑Shield)
steps.instruction: If samples were not stored in DNA/RNA Shield, add either 400 µL DNA/RNA Shield or 200 µL Red Biofluid and Cell buffer plus 200 µL DNA Elution Buffer to each sample and to the negative control.

steps.title: Warm elution buffer
steps.instruction: Place the DNA Elution Buffer in the incubator/hula mixer to warm before use.

steps.title: Store eluate
steps.instruction: Store the DNA eluate at –20 °C.

steps.title: Final vortex of samples
steps.instruction: Vortex the samples for 5 minutes at RT using speed setting 4.
